capabilities: display outlines of multiple daily and periodic notes in a sidebar
filter and extract outline elements by keyword, include, and exclude rules
show files that link back to daily notes
create daily notes for unresolved date links
preview text around outline entries inline or on hover
disambiguation: Not a daily note creator or calendar; it is a read-only outline view over existing daily and periodic notes.
extras: Documentation is provided in both English and Japanese. Creating daily notes for unresolved links can be slow on first run when many links exist. Author accepts donations via Buy Me a Coffee.
intentEvidence: Make sure either Daily Note core plugin or Periodic Notes plugin is enabled.
problem: Daily notes accumulate small thoughts across many files, and it is hard to find later which daily note contains a given item.

relations.evidence: Daily Note Outline v1.0.0- supports for periodic notes.
DNO attempts to use its cache when Dataview plugin is activated.
